$comment: Source of truth for the VGS backend method/capability inventory. scripts/check-backend-inventory.py checks QML backend callsites and (when backend/ exists) Go handlers against this file. Every backend method referenced from QML must map to a capability prefix here or to an 'excluded' prefix with a removal action, otherwise CI fails. Capability names are the VGS-owned names; they mostly match the upstream names except where noted. Phases record the rollout order of the original backend plan.

capabilities.name: loginctl
capabilities.note: lockerReady is tied to confirmed WlSessionLock.secure, never the lock request.

capabilities.name: dbus
capabilities.note: Subscribe-only for PrepareForSleep. call/setProperty/getProperty/getAllProperties/introspect/listNames stay unavailable until an allowlist exists (Open Decision 3).

capabilities.name: mime
capabilities.note: Fed by vshell open + vshell-open.desktop. Targets validated before reaching picker/exec.

capabilities.name: network
capabilities.note: NetworkManager/nmcli backend first; IWD/networkd deferred unless needed.

capabilities.name: freedesktop
capabilities.note: AccountsService icon read/write, portal color-scheme read, icon-theme write, and screensaver inhibitors.

capabilities.name: bluetooth
capabilities.note: BlueZ state/actions plus VGS-owned pairing agent and bluetooth.pairing prompts.

capabilities.name: clipboard
capabilities.note: Native Go clipboard history: the backend owns the single wl-paste watcher, the state file, and the image store, and broadcasts {available, history} on change. The helper clipboard CLI is a manual fallback sharing the same state file and lock.

capabilities.name: gamma
capabilities.note: Compositor adapter: managed hyprsunset with live IPC on Hyprland, managed wlsunset on Niri.

capabilities.name: location
capabilities.note: Cached IP location provider for weather/gamma state.

capabilities.name: wallpaper
capabilities.note: Scheduling/timers only in backend; actual apply calls stay in QML/VGS theme helper.

capabilities.name: wlroutput
capabilities.note: Read-only output snapshot via hyprctl on Hyprland or niri msg on Niri; configuration writes intentionally reject because VGS display config owns compositor layout.

capabilities.name: brightness
capabilities.note: Backend adapts the existing VGS brightness helper so Apple/XDR/Studio paths remain helper-owned.

capabilities.name: cups
capabilities.note: Standard CUPS CLI bridge with input validation and URI redaction.

capabilities.name: tailscale
capabilities.note: Backend-owned status and actions; default widgets must not shell out to tailscale directly.

capabilities.name: tailscale.watch
capabilities.note: Event-only capability with no methods of its own: it advertises that the backend watches tailscaled's ipn bus (LocalAPI /localapi/v0/watch-ipn-bus, via `tailscale debug watch-ipn`) and broadcasts on the 'tailscale' service whenever the daemon's state, prefs or netmap change. QML gates only its re-fetch cadence on it, and only together with the 'watcherActive' field carried in every tailscale State — the capability says the backend reports watcher health, the field says whether a watcher is actually alive. A capability is advertised once at registration and cannot be withdrawn, so on its own it would keep claiming a watcher that had given up. Empty prefixes is deliberate: it carries no RPC, so the 'no caller or handler' note check-backend-inventory.py prints for it is expected and permanent.

capabilities.name: sysupdate
capabilities.note: Canonical update-count owner with acquire/release scheduling; helper fallback only when capability is absent.

capabilities.name: plugins
capabilities.note: Online plugin registry remains disabled until a VGS-aware registry exists; UI gates on capability absence.

capabilities.name: cloudsync
capabilities.note: Cloud file sync on rclone. The backend is the single owner of the supervised `rclone rcd` process, sync-folder config, schedules, the inotify watcher, FUSE mounts and conflict state; QML never talks to rclone directly. Capability is absent when the rclone binary is missing.

excluded.reason: VGS themes are helper-owned (VGSThemeService / vshell theme). The upstream theme model and theme automation are excluded.
excluded.action: Remove themes.* wrappers and the theme.auto subscription/signal from VGSBackendService (Phase 11 / opportunistic cleanup).

excluded.reason: VGS has no matugen; palette work lives in bin/vshell-helper.

apiVersionGateNote: Raw numeric .apiVersion comparisons in QML are no longer allowed. Use capabilities.includes(...) / methods.includes(...) predicates. Named-constant gates (savedWifiStateApiVersion, expectedApiVersion) are excluded from this count.
